title: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
layout_note: Top half: a tall rounded data panel at left points through a large hollow block arrow into the model, where encoder and decoder stacks stand side by side, both read bottom-up, joined by a 'cross attention' bus that leaves the encoder top, runs over and down, and enters every decoder block. Bottom: a full-width rounded panel 'Multitask training format' whose top edge flares up in a wedge to the decoder's input token strip and draws the token grammar as a left-to-right state machine.
grouping: Three zones. (1) 'Multitask training data (680k hours)': a light-grey rounded panel with four task headings, each followed by a pair of lines, a speaker-head icon with navy quoted speech and a notepad icon with the green transcript ('No speech' uses a loudspeaker icon and an empty-set sign). (2) 'Sequence-to-sequence learning': no panel; encoder blocks are teal and gathered by a teal curly brace labelled 'Transformer Encoder Blocks', decoder blocks are red-pink with a red brace 'Transformer Decoder Blocks'. (3) 'Multitask training format': a light-grey rounded panel holding the state machine and a three-swatch legend in its lower-left corner. Token type is a colour family across zones 2 and 3: orange special tokens, blue text tokens, green timestamp tokens.
shapes_depth: Flat diagram-editor style: rounded rectangles in pastel fills with a thin outline one shade darker, no shadows. Each Transformer block is a rounded tinted tile holding thin outlined bars (MLP and self attention in the encoder; MLP, cross attention and self attention in the decoder) with faint residual lines around them; three blocks per stack, a vertical ellipsis between the top one and the lower two. The conv stem is a lilac trapezoid ('2 x Conv1D + GELU'); positional encodings are a circled sine glyph and a database-cylinder icon, each joined at a circled plus. Token strips are rows of square-cornered adjacent cells coloured by type and ending in an ellipsis cell; the output strip is the input strip shifted one cell left. The input spectrogram is a small raster. Arrows are black with filled heads; red arrows and red curly brackets annotate tasks; dotted black lines are the skip paths to EOT.
proposed_highlight: No single module is singled out: the model is drawn as standard encoder and decoder stacks, told apart by teal against red fills with matching coloured braces and labels. The emphasis goes to the data and the token format: each gets its own large bold-titled panel (the data panel a third of the width, the format panel the full width), and the format panel is a zoom of the decoder's input strip, with red arrows naming the task each special token selects (Language identification, X -> X Transcription, X -> English Translation, Voice activity detection, Custom vocabulary / prompting).
lesson: A token-type colour code is defined once in a small legend and reused in the model's input and output strips and in the state-machine panel that wedges out of the input strip, so that panel reads as an expansion of those tokens without any connecting arrow.

source.read: figure crop and caption; paper text (pages 1-3) for the model name only

notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2212.04356); venue as recorded by Semantic Scholar. Neither the title nor the caption names the model; the id uses the paper's own name ('We call our approach Whisper'). The 'previous text tokens' node carries faint green diagonal stripes over its blue fill. A dotted line runs from NO SPEECH along the bottom of the format panel to EOT.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: multitask multilingual speech recognition and translation

insights.structure: Three zones: a tall grey rounded data panel at top-left, an unboxed encoder/decoder pair at top-right (teal encoder stack and red decoder stack side by side, each grouped by a coloured curly brace), and a full-width grey 'Multitask training format' panel at the bottom that flares up in a wedge from the decoder's input token strip.
insights.data: Training data is shown as paired lines per task (speaker icon + navy quoted speech, notepad icon + green transcript, in English, Spanish and Korean), audio input is a small log-Mel spectrogram raster under a lilac Conv1D trapezoid, and decoder input/output are rows of adjacent square cells coloured orange (special), blue (text) and green (timestamp), the output row shifted one cell left.
insights.emphasis: The model itself is drawn as stock Transformer blocks; the contribution (data scale and token format) gets the two big bold-titled panels, and red arrows with labels name the task each special token selects (Language identification, X->X Transcription, X->English Translation, VAD, Custom vocabulary).
insights.flow: Read left to right: data panel -> large hollow block arrow -> spectrogram, encoder up bottom-to-top, a 'cross attention' bus leaving the encoder top and dropping into every decoder block, decoder up to next-token output; then down into the bottom state machine read left to right from a start dot through PREV / SOT / LANGUAGE TAG / TRANSCRIBE-or-TRANSLATE / timestamps to EOT, with dotted skip paths to EOT.
insights.avoid: The bottom state machine is dense (crossing arrows between TRANSCRIBE/TRANSLATE and begin-time/NO TIMESTAMPS, a long dotted line along the panel bottom from NO SPEECH to EOT) and the block-internal labels (MLP, cross attention, self attention) are set very small inside thin bars.

arrangement.units: top-left: grey rounded panel of data examples; top-right: unboxed model area with teal/red block stacks grouped by curly braces; bottom: full-width grey rounded panel that zooms into the decoder input strip
arrangement.inputs_as: quoted example sentences with speaker/notepad icons in a panel, feeding a log-Mel spectrogram raster via a hollow block arrow
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; a 'next-token prediction' label on the arrow out of the decoder top
arrangement.shared: token-type colour code (orange/blue/green) reused across the model's token strips and the format panel
